patch_description: The largest remaining metric gap is noise_reduction (0.34 vs historical 0.59). No existing cascade stage improves it, so I add the recommended Stage 3.5: a 5-tap median snap applied directly to `x_smooth` (the robust-SG output) before the recency-weighted convolution. The snap computes edge-padded 5-tap medians via `sliding_window_view` + `np.median(axis=1)`, then blends 50/50 only where the local step size falls below 0.5× the robust local-σ threshold (MAD-of-diffs), exactly mirroring the validated final snap mechanism. This suppresses residual amplitude noise on the smoothed track without disturbing the validated Kalman/SG/recency stages, reducing residual variance against the clean signal (noise_reduction) while keeping genuine steps (which exceed the threshold) intact. All other stages, I/O conventions, and function signatures are unchanged.
